title: Add unit/integration tests for streaming token metering (partials + disconnects)
creator: Logan Wright
description:
Background
We’ve had multiple investigations (Finance + Support) where billed tokens appear to be double-counted or inconsistent for streaming responses, especially when:
- the client disconnects mid-stream
- the server retries/fallbacks mid-stream
- partial chunks are emitted and then the request terminates with a timeout/cancel

This ticket adds regression coverage so metering invariants are enforced in CI/staging. Goal is to prevent a recurrence of the double-counting bugs seen in the retry/fallback path and to make the semantics explicit for RevRec.

Scope
1) Unit tests at the token meter boundary:
- Streamed chunk accounting matches final “billed_tokens” record
- Partial stream + client disconnect does NOT bill completion tokens that were never emitted/committed
- Server-side retry/fallback within a request does NOT double count prompt tokens
- Tool/function-call deltas do not cause token attribution to shift across segments unexpectedly

2) Integration tests in staging (billing hooks enabled):
- E2E streaming request with deterministic content; verify usage_event emitted exactly once (idempotency)
- E2E streaming request where client cancels after N chunks; verify billed tokens == sum of emitted tokens (plus prompt tokens once)
- E2E streaming request with injected transient failure triggering server retry; verify billed tokens are not duplicated

Non-goals
- Changing the billing logic itself (covered by ENG-4430 / PRs). This ticket is test-only unless we find a gap that requires a small fix.

Notes
- All tests must run without relying on external model providers. Use the local deterministic tokenizer + stubbed streaming generator.
- Where exact token counts differ by tokenizer/model, assert invariants (monotonicity, “once per request”, and “no tokens after disconnect”) + validate against a golden trace for one canonical model.
acceptance_criteria:
- Unit tests cover: (a) normal stream completion, (b) client disconnect mid-stream, (c) server retry/fallback mid-stream, (d) timeout/cancel semantics.
- Integration test suite covers at least two scenarios in staging: client disconnect and injected retry.
- Tests are deterministic and stable (no flakes across 100 CI runs).
- CI gates on these tests for metering-related changes (tagged suite).
- Documentation note added in test README describing expected billing semantics for disconnects/retries.
implementation_notes:
Approach
- Add a StreamingMeterTestHarness that can:
  - feed “chunks” (text deltas + metadata) to the metering layer
  - simulate onChunk/onComplete/onError/onClientDisconnect callbacks
  - optionally inject a retry branch (same request_id, different attempt_id)
- Ensure the harness constructs the exact usage_event payload that billing hooks would emit (same schema + dedupe key).

Key invariants asserted
1) Prompt tokens are billed at most once per request_id.
2) Completion tokens are billed only for chunks that are emitted AND committed (no billing after disconnect/cancel).
3) If a retry occurs, only one attempt may produce billable completion tokens; prompt tokens are not re-billed.
4) usage_event idempotency key remains stable across retries for the same request_id.
5) Total billed_tokens == billed_prompt_tokens + billed_completion_tokens.

Edge cases
- Disconnect after headers but before first chunk: billed_completion_tokens == 0.
- Disconnect between chunks: last partial delta that was not flushed/committed should not be billed.
- Server retry after partial chunks: choose either (a) only first attempt bills emitted chunks OR (b) only final successful attempt bills; current spec is (a) bill only emitted/committed tokens, regardless of attempt, but dedupe prevents double counting.

Files / locations (expected)
- runtime/metering/*: unit tests for meter state machine
- billing-hooks/*: integration tests validating usage_event output + dedupe behavior
- perf-canary scenarios tracked separately (see link) but reused fixtures where possible
test_plan:
Local
- Run unit test suite: metering_streaming_test
- Run integration tests against local services: billing_hooks_integration_test --scenario=stream_disconnect,stream_retry

CI
- Add to “metering” tagged suite so it runs on:
  - changes under runtime/metering, billing-hooks, openai-compat
  - any PR with label: metering

Staging validation
- Deploy to staging with billing hooks enabled.
- Execute scripted client that cancels at a fixed chunk index.
- Query usage_event table for request_id: verify exactly one event with correct billed token totals.

Failure triage
- If a flake occurs, capture:
  - emitted chunk log (sequence numbers)
  - meter state transitions
  - final usage_event payload
  - dedupe key and ledger write outcome
rollout_plan:
No customer-facing rollout (test-only).
- Land unit tests first behind CI tag.
- Land integration tests next; if integration tests increase CI time > +3 minutes, run them on merge queue + nightly until optimized.
- Notify Finance/RevRec once merged so they can reference the “disconnect semantics” test as supporting evidence for meter behavior.
comments: 2026-02-04 (Logan Wright): Marking P0 given Support escalation + Finance audit notes. We need regression tests before we do any further metering refactors. Please align invariants with Nadia’s meter spec draft; exact counts can vary by tokenizer but invariants must hold.

2026-02-06 (Leila Farouk): Started harness. Confirmed we can simulate client disconnect by cancelling the stream context and forcing onClientDisconnect before onComplete. Will assert that completion tokens do not advance after disconnect and that we still emit a single usage_event (status=cancelled) with billed_completion_tokens based on flushed chunks only.

2026-02-08 (Nadia Rahman): Invariant clarification: For streaming, only tokens associated with emitted chunks count as completion tokens. Prompt tokens count once per request_id even if server retries/fallbacks internally. If retry occurs after partial completion, we bill emitted completion tokens once; dedupe must prevent any second emission. Please add a test that fails if two usage_events are emitted for the same request_id.

2026-02-11 (Cole Summers): Integration tests should validate billing-hooks dedupe: same request_id + idempotency_key cannot write twice. If the retry branch tries to emit, it should be dropped with a clear log metric (dedupe_drop_count). Please include assertion for that metric in the integration scenario if possible.

2026-02-14 (Leila Farouk): Unit tests landed locally; integration tests are slightly flaky due to timing around chunk flush. Switching to deterministic chunk scheduler and explicit flush() call in harness. Also adding golden trace for one canonical model to validate a known tokenization path (but keeping invariants as primary assertions).
2026-02-18 (Connor O'Brien): Please ensure these tests run in merge queue for metering-labeled PRs. We had a canary invariant failure last week and want earlier detection.

2026-02-21 (Leila Farouk): Merged. CI now blocks on metering_streaming_test and two staging-like integration scenarios. Added README note on disconnect semantics and where to find the trace logs when a test fails.
changelog: 2026-02-08: Invariants updated after review with Nadia/Cole.
2026-02-18: Integration test flake fixed with deterministic scheduler.
